# homarr_app (List Resource)

Lists every Homarr app visible to the API key, for `terraform query` (Terraform 1.14 and later). Each result is named after the app and carries its identity, ready for an `import` block; with `include_resource = true` it also carries every attribute of `homarr_app`.

Any API key can list apps: a key without the `app-modify-all` permission is answered from `GET /api/apps/selectable`, which reports the same fields. The list takes no arguments.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List resources need Terraform 1.14 or newer. Run `terraform query` to see the
# apps, or `terraform query -generate-config-out=apps.tf` to write an import
# block and a resource block for each one.
list "homarr_app" "all" {
  provider = homarr

  # Report every attribute of each app, not just its identity, so the
  # generated resource blocks are complete.
  include_resource = true
}
```
